src/browser-blossom-compat.ts.name: Old Blossom address warning
src/browser-blossom-compat.ts.description: Warns once per page load when a napplet uses the old blossom:sha256: address form, naming the replacement.

src/browser-blossom-events.ts.name: Blossom server lookup
src/browser-blossom-events.ts.description: Finds an event author's Blossom servers from their BUD-03 list, on demand, so later resource reads know where to fetch.

src/browser-blossom-uri.ts.name: Blossom address parser
src/browser-blossom-uri.ts.description: Checks the shape of an untrusted blossom: address before any lookup or download.

src/browser-fs-support.ts.name: File system helpers
src/browser-fs-support.ts.description: Holds the NAP-FS types, path checks, read, write, revision and watch caps, the watch poll interval, and byte conversions used by the file system.

src/browser-fs.ts.name: Napplet file system
src/browser-fs.ts.description: Gives napplets a NAP-FS file system backed by the browser's file picker and private storage, with per-napplet grants.

src/browser-resource.ts.name: Resource fetcher
src/browser-resource.ts.description: Fetches NAP-RESOURCE content (including Blossom blobs) for isolated napplets, with caps on size, count and servers.

src/browser-upload.ts.name: Blossom uploads
src/browser-upload.ts.description: Uploads napplet files to Blossom servers chosen by the host, enforcing size and type limits.
